title: U.S., Canadian, Coast Guards, Royal Canadian Air Force, rescue 31 fishermen from sinking vessel off Nova Scotia
description: U.S. Coast Guard Air Station Cape Cod MH-60 Jayhawk crews assisted the Royal Canadian Air Force with the rescue of the crew of Atlantic Destiny, 143-foot Canadian commercial fishing vessel  115 nautical miles south of Nova Scotia, Canada, March 3, 2021. All 31 crew members onboard were safely rescued and no injuries were reported. (U.S. Coast Guard courtesy video/Released)
